method.value: Split into segments at gaps >=1.8 min, fit smoothing splines to Q and U, trim edge points

evidence.quote: we fit a smoothing spline of polynomial order $\kappa \in \{3,4,5\}$ with smoothing factor $\sigma \in \{0.1,0.5\}$ using the Python function `scipy.interpolate.UnivariateSpline`.

validation.value: Splines visually characterize Q and U without obvious over-fitting

evidence.quote: We find that these splines are generally able to characterize the $Q$ and $U$ behavior well, without obvious over-fitting.

analysis_steps.goal: Compute Q-U rotation rate and clockwise fraction

method.value: Signed curvature from three-point derivatives, integrated to total curvature; Omega_QU = slope; f_CW from sign per scan; mean and std over meta-parameter grid as systematic error

evidence.quote: We report the mean and use the standard deviation of these values as a systematic error bar

key_parameters.value: speed limit 2pi/5 rad per tg; curvature zeroed above it

evidence.quote: we place a “speed limit” of $2\pi / 5 \ \mathrm{rad}\,\mathrm{t_g}^{-1}$.

method.value: Compute Omega_QU and f_CW in 10 windows of 1500 tg per model; models pass if 1 sigma regions overlap observations

evidence.quote: Models pass if their 1$\sigma$ confidence region overlaps with the 1$\sigma$ confidence region of observations.
we consider the fraction of $25 \ t_g$ segments within each $1500 \ t_g$ window which are clockwise.

findings_qualitative.value: Face-on clockwise MAD models are most likely to match; SANE models too depolarized

evidence.quote: face-on and clockwise ($i>90^\circ$) MAD models are most likely to match observational constraints.

claims.hypothesis: Clockwise Q-U motion exists on quiescent days, not only post-flare
claims.experiment: Curvature-based rotation rate on 2017 ALMA light curves
claims.finding: Clockwise motion on all three days

evidence.quote: We consistently recover clockwise motion in the $Q-U$ plane, that is $\Omega_{QU} < 0$, for all time intervals of data, not only April 11th.

claims.hypothesis: GRMHD models can be constrained by Omega_QU and f_CW
claims.experiment: Compare 1 sigma overlap for model library
claims.finding: Favors clockwise-rotating strongly magnetized flows, supporting external Faraday screen

evidence.quote: face-on, clockwise-rotating models with strong magnetic fields are most likely to be consistent with the observations.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Antonopoulou+2025 model of counter-clockwise disk with clockwise hotspots appears disfavored

evidence.quote: Our analysis appears to disfavor this model
